knowledge.title: Automation Systems
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev builds custom automation systems that eliminate repetitive tasks, reduce manual work, improve efficiency, and connect multiple business applications into intelligent workflows.

knowledge.title: Business Automation
knowledge.content: Business automation includes customer support, CRM updates, lead management, invoice processing, notifications, scheduling, approvals, reporting, document processing, and workflow automation.

knowledge.title: Workflow Automation
knowledge.content: Workflow automation connects applications through APIs, webhooks, triggers, conditions, queues, and background workers to automate end-to-end business processes.

knowledge.title: AI Automation
knowledge.content: AI automation combines large language models with automation workflows to classify data, summarize documents, answer customer questions, generate reports, analyze information, and make intelligent decisions.

knowledge.title: CRM Automation
knowledge.content: CRM automation includes automatic lead creation, follow-ups, reminders, customer segmentation, email sequences, pipeline updates, and sales notifications.

knowledge.title: Marketing Automation
knowledge.content: Marketing automation includes email campaigns, lead nurturing, social media scheduling, content publishing, analytics, and customer engagement workflows.

knowledge.title: Social Media Automation
knowledge.content: Social media automation supports AI-generated content, caption creation, hashtag generation, scheduling, publishing, analytics, and multi-platform management.

knowledge.title: Meta Ads Automation
knowledge.content: Meta Ads automation includes campaign management, reporting, audience targeting, budget monitoring, performance analytics, and automated optimization.

knowledge.title: API Integrations
knowledge.content: Automation systems integrate with REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, webhooks, CRMs, payment gateways, cloud services, and third-party platforms.

knowledge.title: Supported Integrations
knowledge.content: Supported integrations include OpenAI, WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail, Outlook, Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, Stripe, PayPal, Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and custom APIs.

knowledge.title: Document Automation
knowledge.content: Automation can extract text from PDFs, invoices, forms, Word documents, Excel files, and scanned documents using OCR and AI.

knowledge.title: Deployment
knowledge.content: Automation systems are deployed using Docker, FastAPI, cloud servers, VPS, AWS, Azure, Railway, Render, and DigitalOcean.

faqs.question: What automation services do you provide?
faqs.answer: GrowthsStack.Dev provides business automation, AI automation, workflow automation, CRM automation, marketing automation, document automation, API integrations, and social media automation.

faqs.question: Can you automate my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design custom automation systems that reduce manual work, connect your software, and streamline business operations.

faqs.question: Can you automate CRM workflows?
faqs.answer: Yes. CRM automation includes lead management, follow-ups, reminders, customer updates, notifications, and reporting.

faqs.question: Can you automate emails?
faqs.answer: Yes. Email automation includes welcome emails, follow-ups, reminders, marketing campaigns, and notifications.

faqs.question: Can you automate WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes. WhatsApp Business API can be integrated for customer support, notifications, lead generation, and automated messaging.

faqs.question: Can you automate Google Sheets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Google Sheets can automatically receive data, update records, generate reports, and trigger workflows.

faqs.question: Can you integrate OpenAI?
faqs.answer: Yes. OpenAI can be integrated into automation workflows for AI-powered responses, document processing, summarization, and intelligent decision making.

faqs.question: Can you automate document processing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Documents such as PDFs, invoices, forms, and spreadsheets can be automatically analyzed, classified, summarized, and stored.

faqs.question: Can you automate social media posting?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI can generate captions, hashtags, schedule posts, publish content, and track analytics.

faqs.question: Can you automate Meta Ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. Campaign monitoring, reporting, budget tracking, and optimization workflows can be automated.
